description: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) herbal-monograph assessment status for one herb by Latin name — the HMPC assessment status code and label (e.g. finalised, ongoing call for scientific data), the outcome of the European assessment (EU herbal monograph and/or EU list entry), and a note on well-established-use vs traditional-use classification. Answers "is the EMA valerian monograph well-established use or traditional use", "what is the assessment status of the EU chamomile monograph".
name: herb_monograph_status
title: Herb Monograph Status
